ETag.description: Opaque scope-bound revision validator for this authorized representation; it is not a mutation idempotency key.

CSRFToken.description: Required and verified for authenticated browser mutations; never substitutes for the current session or explicit authorization.
CSRFToken.name: X-CSRF-Token

IfMatch.description: Required for a new mutation after current authorization and receipt lookup; exact replay is resolved before new-mutation revision checks. A supplied value must match the intent envelope.
IfMatch.name: If-Match

RunStateFilter.description: Restrict the workspace-scoped page to one canonical run state.
RunStateFilter.name: state

TaskID.description: Deterministic reversible opaque encoding of the exact run and stored task IDs inside the authorized workspace; it is not a bearer capability or alternate selector.
TaskID.name: task_id

Problem403.description: The required grant is unavailable after authorized scope resolution

Problem404.description: Resource is absent or hidden by scope

Problem409.description: Intent, capability, specification, resume, or foundation conflict

Problem410.description: A known resolved retry receipt has expired

Problem412.description: The supplied control revision is stale

Problem428.description: A required control revision is absent

Problem429.description: A workspace pending-count or oldest-pending-age limit is reached

Problem503.description: Capability, control store, unknown acceptance, or deployment overload

reauthenticate.description: Request a fresh signed OIDC authentication time using max_age=0 and prompt=login.

credential_ref.description: Opaque server-owned reference only; no key locator, account witness or secret material.

authenticated_at.description: Verified signed OIDC authentication time when present; issuance time is not substituted.

device_proof.description: One-time PM device proof, never a provider credential.

EffectSummary.description: Exact durable effect counts; every counter is present, including zero.

ExactCounter.description: Lossless nonnegative decimal counter for Go and browser consumers.

MemberOutcome.description: Exact durable member disposition; aggregate transport success cannot substitute for this record.

OrchestrationCondition.description: Timestamped orchestration observation only; it never replaces PostgreSQL-owned effect truth.

pm_session_credential.description: Original one-time PM login credential for the client's OS credential store, never a provider token.

Revision.description: Lossless positive decimal revision for Go and browser consumers.

cancel_requested.description: Confirms durable intent only, never provider termination.

RunIntentReference.description: Safe immutable accepted operation-or-plan identity; it excludes the RunSpec, grant and inputs.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor bound to the authorized workspace and filters; it does not promise a frozen cross-page snapshot.

result_ref.description: Opaque immutable server-owned result reference, never an inline provider value or credential.

result_references.description: Explicitly empty until immutable result references are available.

approval_ref.description: Explicit approval context; null records that the selected recovery contract has no approval reference.

recovery_generation.description: Explicit immutable recovery-generation identity; never inferred from orchestration state.

RunView.description: Lean authorized projection; never the stored RunSpec, grant, raw inputs, credentials or Temporal history.

blocked_reason.description: Safe reason code when blocked or retained under uncertainty; null otherwise.

cancel_requested.description: Durable cancellation intent only; false or true does not infer provider termination.

connection_refs.description: Immutable accepted connection context used for authorization; no credential or stored grant data.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor bound to the authorized workspace and run; it does not promise a frozen cross-page snapshot.

TaskView.description: Durable task state and exact member truth without raw inputs, schemas, grants or orchestration history.

task_id.description: Deterministic reversible opaque encoding of this exact run and stored task identity; ordinary scoped authorization is still required.

PMBrowserSession.description: Secure HttpOnly SameSite browser transport; state-changing requests additionally require exact origin and session-bound CSRF.
PMBrowserSession.name: __Host-pm_session

get.description: Returns a scope-bound cursor page of safe run projections. Each projection identifies the immutable accepted connection and operation-or-plan context; it does not expose the RunSpec, execution grant, inputs, credentials or orchestration internals.

200.description: Scope-bound run page

get.description: Authorizes the immutable accepted connection and operation-or-plan context before returning current PostgreSQL-owned run and effect truth. Revocation of execution authority does not rewrite or by itself hide an otherwise authorized historical run view.

200.description: Safe run projection

post.description: Persists an authorized cancellation command under the scoped request key. HTTP 202 means the command is durable; it never asserts that orchestration stopped or that provider work was terminated. Current authorization is checked before replay disclosure. Exact replay may be resolved before the current If-Match comparison; every new mutation requires If-Match.

202.description: Durable cancellation command, original or exact replay

get.description: Returns only currently available immutable result references beside PostgreSQL-owned effect truth. An empty result_references array is explicit; orchestration closure never fabricates a result or a successful effect.

200.description: Truthful run result-reference projection

get.summary: List available result references for one authorized run

post.description: Names the recovery generation and approval context explicitly and preserves every unresolved effect. HTTP 202 accepts only the durable recovery command, not a provider-effect outcome. An unavailable or ineligible handler returns HTTP 409 resume_unavailable. Current authorization precedes replay disclosure; exact replay may precede the current If-Match comparison, while every new mutation requires If-Match.

202.description: Durable recovery generation, original or exact replay
